rationale: Unifies existing dialog composition and repairs inconsistent spacing, coupled help hover and disclosure/button styling present in stable v1.82.0. No settings model or plan behavior change; user-visible consistency and reusable primitives are delivered together.

summary.ru: Единые отступы, кнопки, подсказки и спойлеры в диалогах настроек.
summary.en: Consistent spacing, buttons, contextual help and disclosures across settings dialogs.
